summary: RETEST of iteration_50 fixes: ALL FIXED. Backend 17/17 pytest pass (new test_iteration51_gift_fixes.py 6 tests + iteration50 regression 11). Frontend: all requested flows verified via Playwright.
verified_fixes: Free user proche: /app/famille -> famille-new-challenge -> /app/challenges/new shows form (no paywall), creates challenge -> /app/challenges/{token}. Unrelated free user sees 'Réservé aux abonnés et à leur famille'.

/activer: typing 'GQ-5EBA-NRL2' key by key (delay 80ms) gives the exact code; typing without prefix, lowercase with prefix, and paste all give the right code; lookup shows preview. 8 new codes checked, none start with 'GQ' in the first block.

Lifetime redeem: TEST_ user set (in DB) to premium solo with plan_expires_at null -> redeem famille: API plan_expires_at null, tier famille_v2, /auth/me expiry still null; /activer success shows 'votre accès à vie est conservé'.
PDF of a cancelled code -> 404 (was 200 before cancel).
Gift checkout with no origin_url -> 200; with evil origin_url -> 200, code uses server FRONTEND_URL (could not read success_url back from Stripe because of the emergent proxy key; checked in code).
A Famille owner accepting another family's invite -> 409, and stays owner; a free user can then accept the same invite (200).
FamilyAccessTable at 390px: stacked list (table display:none), no overflow, nothing clipped on /offrir and /app/famille (role none); at desktop it is a table.
/offrir?offre=solo: hero shows 'Offre Solo' text and 49 €, no family table; picking famille shows Famille text and 79 € plus the table.

/app/account: 'Formule Famille active' / 'Formule Solo active' (account-plan-name); GQ- code typed in lowercase into account-promo-input redeems it ('Offre Famille — 1 an activée', badge updates); entering it again -> 'déjà été activé'.
Admin create-code form clears the recipient and buyer names after creation; at 390px the /app/famille leaderboard rows are readable with no overflow.
Regression: /app/pricing has 3 cards (Gratuit / Solo 49 € / Famille 79 €, monthly 4,90 € / 7,90 €, no Héritage); /offrir submit redirects to checkout.stripe.com.

issues: '0 joueur' count wraps onto two lines next to the challenge title (cosmetic).
